dedupe_keys.name: artci telecom statistics quarterly and annual market reports and dashboards cote d ivoire

description: The Autorité de Régulation des Télécommunications/TIC de Côte d'Ivoire (ARTCI), the telecom and ICT regulator of Côte d'Ivoire, publishes quarterly statistical reports built from the operators' declared data. On 28 September 2026 the quarterly statistics page listed reports from the fourth quarter of 2023 to the second quarter of 2026, with the latest dated 26 August 2026; the site also has pages for annual statistics, postal market statistics, dashboards (tableaux de bord) and annual activity reports (2022 and 2023). ARTCI is also the body behind broadband mapping in the country and was holding a regional GIS training on broadband mapping in September 2026. Coverage is national; resolution is per operator and per quarter. Format and access: PDF reports; the dashboards page sits behind a JavaScript check and could not be read from the cloud. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: figures are operator declarations, reports are PDFs, not data files, and the dashboards need a browser. Simulation uses: subscriber, traffic and network market indicators for telecom capacity and service performance analysis. Related records: comparable to the AGER São Tomé telecom statistical indicators and the ECTEL Eastern Caribbean sector review.
